title: Pilaf with Lemony Pepper Crust
description: A flavorful pilaf dish coated with a zesty lemony pepper crust, perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add uncooked pilaf, stir to coat with oil and onions.
Add chopped lemony and whole peppercorns, stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low, cover and cook for 5-7 minutes or until the pilaf is cooked.
Fluff pilaf with a fork and serve immediately.
